title: Factual Access States in Diffusion Language Models: From Mechanism to Knowledge Editing and Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.27580v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Factual recall is a lookup: some representation inside the network serves as the key, and what that key is made of decides which queries can retrieve the fact, what an edit must cover, and what a retriever can read. We call it the factual access state. In autoregressive (AR) models the subject position enriches attributes largely independently of the relation, and relation-specific selection happens later, at the readout position. In masked diffusion language models (DLMs) we find the state is assembled differently, and much earlier: in the first attention layer the wording of the relation is routed into the position of whichever entity is visible and the early feed-forward layers look the fact up on this fused representation. The state therefore varies with the relation's surface form and with the query direction, so the queries about one fact occupy a region of state space rather than a point, and an operation on the fact succeeds on

translated_title: 扩散语言模型中的事实访问状态：从机制到知识编辑与检索
translated_abstract: 事实回忆本质上是一种查找：网络内部的某种表示充当键，而该键的构成决定了哪些查询能够检索到该事实、一次编辑必须覆盖哪些内容、以及检索器能够读取到什么。我们将其称为“事实访问状态”。在自回归（AR）模型中，主语位置对属性的丰富过程在很大程度上独立于关系，而针对关系的选择发生在较晚的读出位置。在掩码扩散语言模型（DLMs）中，我们发现该状态的组装方式不同，且时间上早得多：在第一层注意力层中，关系的措辞被路由到可见实体的位置上，随后早期的前馈层基于这一融合表示查找事实。因此，该状态会随关系的表面形式和查询方向而变化，这意味着关于同一事实的查询占据的是状态空间中的一个区域而非一个点，而对事实的操作能否成功则取决于（摘要在此处截断，未完）
tldr: 该论文揭示了扩散语言模型在第一层注意力层就通过将关系措辞路由到可见实体位置来组装事实访问状态，这一机制与自回归模型的组装方式截然不同且发生更早，为知识编辑与检索提供了新的机制层面依据。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that masked diffusion language models assemble factual access states much earlier than autoregressive models—by routing relation wording into visible entity positions in the first attention layer—providing mechanistic insights for knowledge editing and retrieval.
